ValidationRule.description: Ensures required fields are not null for Card Dispute cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Don't recognise the transaction"), OR( ISBLANK(Customer_Description__c), ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, 'No') && ISPICKVAL(Card_In_Possession_During_Transaction__c,''), ISPICKVAL(Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c,'') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Customer Description, Is The Card Lost/Stolen and Has The Card Been Stopped. If the Card In Possession During Transaction is No, then Card In Possession During Transaction is required.
